title: Garrison / Runs
description: Run lifecycle on the control plane: creation, outcomes, cancellations, structured output, events, and queue gauges.

list.name: tenant
list.label: Tenant
list.description: Tenant ID. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: harness
list.label: Harness
list.description: Harness type. Empty until the first run is created.

list.name: model
list.label: Model
list.description: Served model as the harness reported it; none when it did not report one.

list.name: window
list.label: Average over
list.description: Window for rates, averages, and percentiles. Runs are infrequent, so short windows leave gaps.

list.name: run
list.label: Run ID
list.description: Filters log panels to lines that contain this run ID.

panels.title: Runs created
panels.description: Runs created in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_runs_created_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Runs finished
panels.description: Runs that reached a terminal status.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Failed runs
panels.description: Finished runs whose outcome was not Succeeded.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{outcome!="Succeeded", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Cancellations
panels.description: Cancellation requests accepted in the selected range.

targets.expr: round(sum(increase(garrison_runs_cancellations_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Waiting now
panels.description: Runs waiting for a worker (Pending and Queued), cluster-wide.

targets.expr: max(garrison_runs_queued) or on() vector(0)

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Active now
panels.description: Runs leased, running, or cancelling, cluster-wide.

targets.expr: max(garrison_runs_active) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Runs created by harness, kind, and executor (per minute)
panels.description: Runs created per minute.

targets.expr: sum by (harness, kind, executor) (rate(garrison_runs_created_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "harness", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Runs finished by outcome (per minute)
panels.description: Terminal runs per minute, by outcome.

targets.expr: sum by (outcome) (rate(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "outcome", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Outcomes in the selected range
panels.description: Finished runs by outcome.

targets.expr: round(sum by (outcome) (increase(garrison_runs_finished_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$__range]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "outcome", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Cancellations by reason
panels.description: Cancellations by reason: request (API, MCP, A2A), disconnect (cancelOnDisconnect), parent (cascade from a cancelled parent).

targets.expr: round(sum by (reason) (increase(garrison_runs_cancellations_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent"}[$__range]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "reason", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Unfinished runs (cluster-wide)
panels.description: Waiting and active runs over time.

targets.expr: max(garrison_runs_queued) or on() vector(0)
max(garrison_runs_active) or on() vector(0)

links.title: Claim and compile traces in Tempo

panels.title: Run time (queued to completed)
panels.description: Total run time percentiles. Exemplar dots open the run's trace.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="total", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="total", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{stage="total", tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Stage p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of each run stage: queue, claim, compile, startup, first_token, streaming, execution, delegation_wait, total.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, stage) (rate(garrison_run_stage_duration_seconds_bucket{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", deployment=~"$deployment", harness=~"$harness", model=~"$model"}[$window]))) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "stage", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Schema validations by result
panels.description: Validations of run output against the agent's output schema, by result and execution (original or repair).

targets.expr: sum by (result, execution) (increase(garrison_runs_schema_validations_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "result", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Repairs started
panels.description: Structured output repair attempts started, by agent.

targets.expr: sum by (agent) (increase(garrison_runs_repairs_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent", harness=~"$harness"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "agent", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Run events received by type (per minute)
panels.description: Run events received from workers, by event type.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (rate(garrison_run_events_total[$__rate_interval])) * 60 or on() label_replace(vector(0), "type", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Events per batch
panels.description: Median and 95th percentile events per batch received from workers.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_event_batch_size_bucket[$window]))) or on() vector(0)
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(garrison_event_batch_size_bucket[$window]))) or on() vector(0)

panels.title: Run traces
panels.description: Recent run creation spans; open one to see claim, compile, worker execution, and report spans in one trace.

panels.title: Run logs
panels.description: Server and worker lines about runs. Use the Run ID box to narrow them.

targets.expr: {app="garrison", component=~"server|worker"} |~ "run=run_" |~ "agent=${agent:regex}" |= "$run"

panels.title: Conversation turns by mode
panels.description: Conversation turns created, by how the harness session started: first (a new conversation), resume (the session on the node that holds it), or fallback (a fresh session seeded with the transcript of the earlier turns).

targets.expr: sum by (mode) (increase(garrison_conversation_turns_total{tenant=~"$tenant", agent=~"$agent"}[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "mode", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Conversation fallbacks by reason
panels.description: Turns that could not resume their harness session and started a fresh one from the transcript. AffinityNodeLost and WorkspaceLost point at lost workers or swept directories; AffinityWaitExpired at a busy affinity node.

targets.expr: sum by (reason) (increase(garrison_conversation_fallbacks_total[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "reason", "none", "", "")

panels.title: Turns refused as busy
panels.description: Conversation turns refused with 409 ConversationBusy because the previous turn had not finished, by surface (rest, mcp, a2a). A steady rate means clients send turns without waiting for answers.

targets.expr: sum by (surface) (increase(garrison_conversation_busy_total[$__rate_interval])) or on() label_replace(vector(0), "surface", "none", "", "")
